calls.statement:
SELECT 'dup_sales' k, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) d, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) d2, min(etl_loaded_at)::varchar mn, max(etl_loaded_at)::varchar mx
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dup_ret', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id), COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id), min(return_date)::varchar, max(return_date)::varchar
FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'rpt', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT (business_date, store_id)), COUNT(DISTINCT store_id), min(business_date)::varchar, max(business_date)::varchar
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28'

WITH lines AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, f.sale_date AS business_date, f.net_amount AS amt
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT s.store_id, r.return_date, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28'
), mine AS (SELECT store_id, SUM(amt) net, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN amt>0 THEN business_date END) sale_days FROM lines GROUP BY 1),
rp AS (SELECT store_id, SUM(net_sales) rpt_net, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN net_sales_before_returns<>0 THEN business_date END) rpt_days FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT coalesce(m.store_id,rp.store_id) id, m.net, rp.rpt_net, round(m.net-rp.rpt_net,2) diff, m.sale_days, rp.rpt_days
FROM mine m FULL JOIN rp ON rp.store_id=m.store_id ORDER BY 1

WITH net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
period_days AS (
    SELECT calendar_date FROM dim_date
    WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period = 2 AND is_trading_day
),
store_sales AS (
    SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n JOIN period_days d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    GROUP BY 1
),
trading AS (
    SELECT cs.store_id, cs.store_name, COUNT(*) AS trading_days
    FROM dim_store cs
    CROSS JOIN period_days d
    WHERE cs.is_current AND cs.store_id < 900
      AND (cs.open_date IS NULL OR cs.open_date <= d.calendar_date)
      AND (cs.close_date IS NULL OR cs.close_date >= d.calendar_date)
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                      WHERE c.store_id = cs.store_id
                        AND d.calendar_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date)
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.net_sales / t.trading_days DESC) AS rank,
       t.store_id, t.store_name,
       ROUND(ss.net_sales / t.trading_days, 2) AS net_sales_per_trading_day,
       t.trading_days, ROUND(ss.net_sales,2) AS net_sales
FROM trading t JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.store_id = t.store_id
ORDER BY 1
